title: Mia and Leo's Games
text:
Mia has a red ball. She plays with it in the park every day. Her brother Leo likes games too. He has a blue kite and a small car.

On Sunday, Mia and Leo play a board game at home. The game is called Snakes and Ladders. Mia wins the game, and Leo laughs. They play again after lunch.

questions.text: What game do Mia and Leo play on Sunday?
What can we guess about Mia from the first paragraph?
options: She lives far from the park

questions.text: Why do Mia and Leo play again after lunch?
options: They want to play more games together
They have to clean the house

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people play
a toy that flies in the wind on a long string
a game played on a flat board with pieces that you move
the meal you eat in the middle of the day

paragraph_translations: Mia tem uma bola vermelha. Ela brinca com ela no parque todos os dias. Seu irmão Leo também gosta de jogos. Ele tem uma pipa azul e um carrinho pequeno.
No domingo, Mia e Leo jogam um jogo de tabuleiro em casa. O jogo se chama Cobras e Escadas. Mia ganha o jogo, e Leo ri. Eles jogam de novo depois do almoço.
